types1:Item.types1:Name: SearchPerson_Process
types1:Item.types1:Description: Build guide 4.6. Searches CPD for an existing person by Ext Id / VINCI ID.

process.name: SearchPerson_Process

parameter.name: EmployeeNumber
parameter.description: Dayforce EmployeeNumber, used as the CPD external identifier

parameter.name: PersonFound
parameter.description: True if SearchPersonByExtId returned a matching person

parameter.name: personVinciId
parameter.description: Existing VINCI ID, populated only when PersonFound=true

parameter.name: ExistingContractId
parameter.description: contractId of the person's active contract, populated only when PersonFound=true

parameter.name: ExistingPhones
parameter.description: Person's existing CPD phone entries, if the search response includes them

process.description: Wraps CPD API 3.2.1 (Search Person, Ext Id / VINCI ID match per project decision). Called once per employee by the Orchestrator (build guide 4.15, step 3), immediately before the Create/Update decision (build guide 4.7).
process.notes: Hand-authored against the CPD-Dayforce Functional Design & API Build Guide v1.0 - see README_IICS_BUILD_NOTES.md for schema caveats. KNOWN LIMITATION carried over from the design doc (section 3.2.1): Ext Id/VINCI ID matching only finds a person once already assigned by a prior successful run, so it cannot on its own distinguish a genuine new hire from one whose CPD assignment failed/hasn't propagated yet. PersonFound=false is therefore treated as "create" by the Orchestrator's Decision step per the functional scenarios; this is a design tradeoff already accepted when choosing this match criteria over name+DOB, not a bug in this sub-process. The sample GetPersons.xml response used to build this mapping did not include a phoneNumber list, so ExistingPhones may come back empty even for persons with phones on file - confirm against a live CPD test call whether phones are returned inline or need a separate call before the phone-reconciliation logic (build guide 4.11) is finalized.

invoke.title: Search CPD person by ext id
